tools.name: list_haplogroups
tools.description: Search or list paternal haplogroups by fuzzy name and/or parent, with stable ordering for full pagination (order=name recommended). 搜索/列出父系单倍群：按名称模糊匹配、按父节点筛选，稳定排序可完整枚举。

tools.name: get_haplogroup
tools.description: Get a single haplogroup by name / hid / SNP. 按名称/hid/SNP 获取单个单倍群详情。

tools.name: get_haplogroup_mutations
tools.description: List a haplogroup defining (equivalent) mutations (paternal / Y tree only). 获取某单倍群的等价突变（defining SNPs）列表（仅父系 Y 树）。

tools.name: get_haplogroup_lineage
tools.description: Get the lineage chain from a haplogroup up to ROOT. Use limit to fetch only the most recent N levels (e.g. limit=2 for the node + its parent). 获取某单倍群上溯到 ROOT 的谱系链；可用 limit 只取最近 N 级（如 limit=2 即该节点与其直接父级）。

tools.name: children_haplogroups
tools.description: Get the direct children of a haplogroup (for level-by-level traversal). Use limit for the N largest subclades only. 获取直接子节点（逐层遍历）；可用 limit 只看最大的 N 个分支。

tools.name: resolve_snp
tools.description: Resolve a SNP name to its haplogroup and return equivalent names (merged-name variants supported). 将 SNP 名解析到所属单倍群并返回等价名。

tools.name: resolve_snps
tools.description: Batch-resolve up to 200 SNP names to their haplogroups (for reading a whole Y-SNP panel). 批量解析多个 SNP 名到所属单倍群（≤200/次）。

tools.name: subtree_haplogroups
tools.description: Get a haplogroup subtree. Defaults to 6 levels (matches the site); small branches (root endcounts<=600) fully expand; max_depth overrides. Truncated boundary nodes carry has_children. 取子树：默认 6 层，小支(endcounts<=600)全展开，可传 max_depth；截断边界带 has_children。

tools.name: get_api_info
tools.description: Get service meta: summary, auth, dataset size (haplogroups / mutation records), and the tool list. 获取本服务元信息：简介、鉴权、数据集规模、工具清单。
